HediffDef.label: Indigestible
HediffDef.description: This pawn is immune to digestion. Not immune to bullets, blades, explosions, or even external acid sprays, but certainly immune to digestion.

HediffDef.label: Acid-proof
HediffDef.description: This pawn is very difficult to digest. Not impossible, but it'll take a while; about four times as long as most prey.

HediffDef.label: Acid-resistant
HediffDef.description: This pawn resists digestion well, and will last about twice as long as most prey in a hostile belly.

HediffDef.label: Normal acid resistance
HediffDef.description: This pawn is digested as easily as anyone else.

HediffDef.label: Melty
HediffDef.description: This pawn melts under acid easily and won't last more than half as long in a hostile belly as most prey.

HediffDef.label: Cotton candy
HediffDef.description: This pawn falls apart in stomach acid like cotton candy, and doesn't fare any better in other organs. They have maybe a quarter of the time to escape as normal prey.

HediffDef.label: Instant digestion
HediffDef.description: Only the pawn-tron reduces an entire preything into soup-like homogenate in 30 seconds.

HediffDef.label: Godlike Digestion
HediffDef.description: Whether due to magic or a technology that's not yet understood, this pawn's digestive abilities are in a class of their own, capable of liquifying an entire Thrumbo in minutes.

HediffDef.label: Scouring acid
HediffDef.description: This pawn can turn prey into nutrient soup in the blink of an eye--or, at least, four times as fast as most predators.

HediffDef.label: Potent acid
HediffDef.description: This pawn can digest prey about twice as fast as most predators.

HediffDef.label: Normal acid strength
HediffDef.description: This pawn digests prey at a normal speed.

HediffDef.label: Weak acid
HediffDef.description: This pawn takes about twice as long to digest live meals as most predators.

HediffDef.label: Watery acid
HediffDef.description: This pawn takes about four times as long to digest prey as most predators. This pawn's food is liable to die of boredom before dying of melting.

HediffDef.label: Normal item damage
HediffDef.description: This pawn damages clothing and implants to a normal degree. The stomach wasn't necessarily designed to digest tough fiber and machined plasteel, but neither were clothes and delicate mechanisms necessarily designed to survive a long acid bath.

HediffDef.label: Traceless digestion
HediffDef.description: This pawn leaves no trace of its prey when it is done digesting. Clothing, implants, power armor? It all turns to mush, if anything at all.

HediffDef.label: Mothlike digestion
HediffDef.description: This pawn has a habit of melting the clothes and prosthetics off its prey when digesting them. Their innards are just so harsh on such petty accessories.

HediffDef.label: Fiber-friendly digestion
HediffDef.description: This pawn's digestive system isn't all that harsh on clothing and other accessories its gurgled prey might have. That's not to say that they'll come out completely unscathed, however.

HediffDef.label: Spotless digestion
HediffDef.description: This pawn has such a clean and purpose-driven digestive system that it can digest prey clean out of their clothes, leaving such vestments not only undamaged, but just as spotless as when they were donned. The same goes for implants and so on.

HediffDef.label: Unacerbic
HediffDef.description: This pawn can't digest anyone--not alive, at least. It has the stretchiness to swallow prey, but none of the acidity to melt them. For nutrition, it has to settle for normal food instead.

HediffDef.label: Hyperacerbic
HediffDef.description: This pawn's innards are totally unsafe, no matter the hole. All roads lead to digestion.

HediffDef.label: No Warmup
HediffDef.description: This pawn needn't to warmup, its organs are operating efficiently at all times, ready to handle prey at any time.

HediffDef.label: Godlike Absorption
HediffDef.description: Through supernatural power or advanced bio-technology, this pawn absorbs energy and matter instantly, gaining full benefits the moment digestion begins.

HediffDef.label: Rapid Absorption
HediffDef.description: This pawn absorbs nutrients four times faster than most creatures, turning digested matter into usable energy at extreme speed.

HediffDef.label: Fast Absorption
HediffDef.description: This pawn absorbs nutrients twice as fast as the average predator.

HediffDef.label: Normal absorption speed
HediffDef.description: This pawn absorbs nutrients at a standard, unmodified rate.

HediffDef.label: Slow Absorption
HediffDef.description: This pawn absorbs nutrients only half as fast as most predators, taking longer to gain benefits from meals.

HediffDef.label: Sluggish Absorption
HediffDef.description: This pawn absorbs nutrients just one‑quarter as fast as normal, taking an extremely long time to benefit from digestion.

HediffDef.label: Blazing Warmup
HediffDef.description: This pawn warms up to act on prey extremely quickly, ready to pounce and process them in record time.

HediffDef.label: Swift Warmup
HediffDef.description: This pawn warms up to prey faster than most predators, able to prepare for digestion or capture with little delay.

HediffDef.label: Normal Warmup
HediffDef.description: This pawn warms up to prey at a standard rate, matching the pace of most predatory peers.

HediffDef.label: Sluggish Warmup
HediffDef.description: This pawn warms up to act on prey slowly, taking longer than average to prepare for capturing or digesting prey.

HediffDef.label: Glacial Warmup
HediffDef.description: This pawn warms up to prey extremely slowly, taking far longer than normal to ready their predatory instincts and actions.
